description: Markdown Visual brings sanitized Markdown rendering to Power BI reports, letting teams embed narratives, release notes, and knowledge base snippets alongside live dashboards without leaving the analytics surface. Who benefits: Data analysts, BI developers, product managers, customer success leads, and operations teams who curate stakeholder-facing Power BI content. Customer pain solved: Dashboards lack contextual explanations, forcing audiences to reference external documents. Reporting teams need a secure way to display Markdown or HTML without exposing unsafe content. Maintaining alignment between metrics and narrative updates across tools is slow and error-prone. Key capabilities: Converts Markdown to HTML with showdown.js and sanitizes every render with DOMPurify for safe sharing. Works offline with zero external dependencies, keeping visuals lightweight and enterprise-friendly. Supports rich formatting including headings, lists, links, and inline callouts directly within Power BI. Use cases: Embed GitHub issue summaries or sprint notes in executive scorecards. Pair KPI charts with onboarding guides, FAQs, or compliance reminders. Publish customer status updates, release highlights, or incident timelines alongside live metrics. With Markdown Visual, teams improve stakeholder understanding, keep context synchronized, and deliver trustworthy annotated dashboards in minutes.
